title: Mirror with Images of Daoist Deities（1929.644）
holder: 芝加哥艺术博物馆（藏品号 1929.644）
year: Eastern Han dynasty (25–220 CE),，2nd or 3rd century CE
one_line: 芝加哥艺术博物馆藏青铜，馆方断代作「Eastern Han dynasty (25–220 CE),，2nd or 3rd century CE」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Mirror with Images of Daoist Deities
Eastern Han dynasty (25–220 CE),，2nd or 3rd century CE

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录芝加哥艺术博物馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qin-han；器类归入依据仅为：Metalwork + bronze（器物向）。

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.title: Urbana Champaign, Krannert Art Museum, University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign, Sacred Mountains in Chinese Art, 1990, cat. 41.
New York, China Institute in America, On Flying Hooves: The Horse in Chinese Art, Oct. 14–Dec. 23, 1995.

provenance.when: 见馆方档案原文（未分段）
provenance.text: Yamanaka and Company, Bar Harbor, ME; sold to Kate Sturges Buckingham (1858–1937), Chicago, [Kate served as executor of her sister Lucy Maud Buckingham's estate and continued expanding Lucy's collection following her death in 1920] Dec. 12, 1929; given to the Art Institute of Chicago, Dec. 12, 1929.
